method: Each URL below was fetched directly in this session. Quoted text is copied from the page as returned. Nothing in this file is inferred, averaged, or carried over from another session's record: values marked 'carried' were re-fetched here.

observations.claim: An Amazon ASIN is a 10-character alphanumeric identifier.
observations.quote: ASIN | Amazon Standard Identification Number: 10-Character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.

observations.claim: Submitted code 1 (B04G1MEwY) is 9 characters, so it is not a valid ASIN, and amazon.com/dp/B04G1MEwY serves Amazon's error page.
observations.observed: len=9. Page <title> returned: 'Page Not Found'. Body: "Sorry! We couldn't find that page."

observations.claim: CONTROL. The query parameter plpRedirect=mhFallback is NOT evidence that a product lookup failed.
observations.observed: A direct GET of three known-valid ASINs with no short link in the path -- /dp/B0CDY277D3, /dp/B09B7SB46R and /dp/B08DKYBTPH -- each ended on a URL carrying 'plpRedirect=mhFallback' (and 'lv=shuf') while serving the correct product page. The parameter therefore appears on ordinary product fetches for this client and says nothing about whether an identifier selected a product.
observations.affects: README.md line asserting the mhFallback route 'confirms the identifiers select nothing'; dashboard/index.html callout calling mhFallback 'Amazon's fallback route, not a product deep link'. Both overstate what the parameter shows.

observations.claim: Operating Agreement section 5 prescribes the disclosure sentence and allows a substantially similar statement.
observations.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."
observations.note: The 'or any substantially similar statement previously allowed' clause means the 'we earn' variant used on some inherited pages is not a verbatim-only failure. Recorded so flag D-F-01 can be closed as not-a-violation rather than left ambiguous.

not_verified_and_therefore_left_blank.why: Prices are served dynamically per session and were not obtainable as a stable, attributable value. The price figures that appear in the fetched page text are attached to 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' carousel items, which are other ASINs, and must not be attributed to the listed product. Participation Requirement 6(y) also bars price tracking, and section 6(t)/Products Statement limit how price and rating data may be shown.

Participation Requirement 6(t) permits star ratings and customer reviews only when obtained through Creators API or PA API. This session has no API credentials, so any number read off the rendered page would violate 6(t) if published. Left blank and flagged.

Table 1 gives rates by category. No official source states the commission category of these three ASINs, and whether an Air Fryers browse node maps to the 'Kitchen' rate is not stated anywhere official. Not derived.

not_verified_and_therefore_left_blank.field: whether the three resolved listings are the products that were intended to be submitted
not_verified_and_therefore_left_blank.why: The submitted tokens are 9-character short-link codes, not ASINs. No official Amazon document describes how link.amazon codes map to targets, and the submitter supplied no product names. This cannot be settled from any official source; it needs the submitter's confirmation. Flagged, not guessed.

not_verified_and_therefore_left_blank.field: best-seller rank, competitor count, clicks, conversions, Associates tag
not_verified_and_therefore_left_blank.why: No official Amazon endpoint publishes these to affiliates without account access; the platform has no live campaign or tag. Left blank by design.

irregularities: The three submitted tokens are 9 characters; an ASIN is 10. The tokens are short-link codes, not ASINs.
plpRedirect=mhFallback appears on direct fetches of valid ASINs too (588-V08), so it is not failure evidence. Earlier text on this site said it was.
The three short links resolve to three different air fryers from three brands. Whether that is the intended set is unconfirmed.
Rendered prices in the fetched page text belong to carousel items for other ASINs, not to the listed product.
